posts.text: Very soft card that however Tats goes in the book on the 9th minute https://t.co/1T1O0tlVMP
Tatters starting today marked his 200th appearance for Sandbach. Outstanding effort and commitment to the club 🙌🏻
5’ gone and both sides have had a decent chance but not capitalised.
Sandbach are up for this game today and line up as follows https://t.co/PgWfOzyqs4

Dec and JKD give their assessment on today’s smash and grab 1  0 win at Brereton Social with a late winner from Hatton.

A big thank you to all the away support who travelled to get here today, it is appreciated and although not a pretty, a win is a win and 3pts is 3pts, get in!! https://t.co/85LJCtYfof

Robbie Hatton is the Hitman today with an added time far post volley from a corner talks us through his thoughts on the game and his late goal.

@RobbieHatton99 https://t.co/zCP4qAee9Z

Brereton Social 0 v Sandbach United 1

It’s over here as The Bach snatch an added time winner courtesy of a far post volley from Hatton. It was generally a drab game with both defences on top and chances few and far between, so delighted to report the narrow win, get in The Bach
